create_Embed_module: create a Haiku Embed module with a given vocab_size and embed_dim for token embedding
create_Embed_with_matrix: create a Haiku Embed module initialized with a precomputed embedding_matrix numpy array
lookup_embeddings_ARRAY_INDEX: lookup token embeddings using ARRAY_INDEX style which uses gather for GPU performance
lookup_embeddings_ONE_HOT: lookup token embeddings using ONE_HOT style which uses dot product for small vocab TPUs
customize_Embed_lookup_style: customize the Embed module lookup_style and precision parameters at call time
